result.reason: The added section reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It leaves the existing survival and confidentiality provisions unchanged and adds only the required exit obligations. Drafting is professional, though the data-return deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than directly from expiry or termination, and using a defined term such as “Customer Data” would be more precise.
